question: How often do relevant quiet same-side moves form exact bounded board-state diamonds across every intervening opponent reply?

design.domain: Non-pawn, non-king, non-rook, non-capture, non-check moves
design.engine_filter: Frozen parent top eight at 20,000 nodes

result: 46 of 352 engine-filtered pairs (13.07%) fully commuted for every legal opponent reply at bounded three-ply board-state level. Advance ordering/TT-convergence research only.
